Name: Beach Wave Sounds
Author: Chread
Description:
[color=#ffd966]No more Custom Music! This content pack[/color][color=#ffd966] only requires [/color][color=#ffd966][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and Stardew Valley 1.6 or higher﻿. For something similar for Custom Music check this out: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7587]Beach Sounds[/url].
[/color]
Hello everyone!

This content pack replaces the waves sounds on the beach. They now feel a lot more realistic and calming. Happy fishing!

To see an example of what this content pack sounds like press the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32469?tab=videos]Videos[/url]" tab.


Installation: Unzip the folder first, then you put the "[CP] Beach Sounds" folder in your Mods folder. This mod requires you to have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043?tab=files&BH=2]Custom Music[/url] is [u]not[/u] required.
Incompatible: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7587]Beach Sounds[/url]﻿.



[i]Future plans:[/i]  Tone down seagull noises as an extra pack. 

If you have any suggestions let me know.

Check out my other content packs [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/chrisdegod/mods]here[/url].
